desc: Derive the arithmetic progression condition: for each present midpoint \(B\), count endpoint pairs satisfying \(A+C=2B\).
Select convolution of the presence array with itself as the worst-case efficient counting method.
Replace infeasible pure-Python NTT with packed big-integer convolution.
Prove convolution coefficients yield each fine triplet exactly once via \((f*f)[2B]\).
Implement robust stdin parsing and integer-safe stdout output.
Validate the packed-convolution solution on all public samples.
